So we need to retrieve information about rewards for Fortnite on PlayStation, including missions and trophies. We can call game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation". However, the user wants "different missions and trophies". The tool allows specifying mission and trophy parameters. But we might need to get all rewards for the game, maybe without specifying mission or trophy? The tool description says: "Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game." It has optional mission and trophy parameters. So we can call it with just game and platform, leaving mission and trophy empty. That should return all rewards for the game on that platform, including different missions and trophies.
